description: The newest position changes of tracked Hyperliquid whales, newest first: opens, closes, increases, decreases, flips and liquidations with coin, side, USD change and price. Use it for "what did the whales just do on SOL?". For on-chain transfers use get_movements.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Only changes of the last hours (optional; default the newest ones). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

min_usd.description: Only changes of at least this many USD (absolute).

name: get_whale_feed

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

events.description: Position changes, newest first (without data): id, ts, address, label, coin, kind, side, sizeDelta, usdDelta, price.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

title: Whale position changes
